name: pi-subagents
notes: Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents; local compatibility fixes preserve @xzzpig/pi-permission-system priority in resolvePermissionSystemExtension() and Pi SDK 0.83 streamFn option naming (intentionally diverges from upstream). Fleet native transcript (openspec fleet-native-transcript): adds src/tui/fleet-native-transcript.ts (JSONL→shared-library entries adapter + Pi-native renderer via guarded dynamic import of @xzzpig/pi-components/transcript), minimal wiring in src/tui/fleet.ts (renderer mode cache branch, v/V toggleRenderer keybinding, legacy fallback), new dependency @xzzpig/pi-components@0.3.0 bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published to npm), and shared readTranscriptRecords export in src/tui/fleet-transcript.ts.
